customerReviewsSample.reviewText: The servings were huge. I'd buy a quart to serve 4 people. Great value for your money. The Cookie Dough Quart was amazing! My favorite by far!

You guys should really mention sizes on your site. Your ice-cream tastes great but I ordered 3 flavors and got enough ice-cream to feed a village , for 18 dollars!!  I am from Canada and 18 dollars usually gets us small portions of ice-cream. This was a whole lot of wastage due to poor descriptions on your order page!
Very yummy but doesn’t look like the photo they added AT ALL. It comes in a store bought quart 🤨 and came all melted :( but still good
False advertised with the pictures. Ice cream was good but they show a picture of a brownie fudge sundae and then I get a tub of ice cream delivered.

faq.question: What is the Twistee Treat of Lake Buena Vista's address?
faq.answer: Twistee Treat of Lake Buena Vista is located at Twistee Treat Of Lake Buena Vista, 11947 S Apopka Vineland Rd, Orlando, FL 32836, USA. This is where you will go to get DoorDash Pickup orders, and where Dashers will go to get your DoorDash delivery orders.

faq.question: Does Twistee Treat of Lake Buena Vista offer delivery or pickup?
faq.answer: You can browse Twistee Treat of Lake Buena Vista’s menu and place an order for both Delivery and Pickup on DoorDash. Twistee Treat of Lake Buena Vista may also offer delivery and pickup on their own or through other delivery services.

faq.question: What are the most popular dishes at Twistee Treat of Lake Buena Vista?
faq.answer: The dishes most commonly ordered by DoorDash customers at Twistee Treat of Lake Buena Vista are Reese's Peanut Butter Cup Quart, Cookie Dough Quart and Cookies and Cream Quart.

faq.question: Is Twistee Treat of Lake Buena Vista a DashPass eligible store?
faq.answer: Twistee Treat of Lake Buena Vista offers DashPass benefits like $0 delivery, reduced service fees, and $5 credits back on Pickup orders. If you want to know if a store is DashPass eligible, you can look for the DashPass icon next to their name.
